overview: The 2026 manual reflects major changes in licensing and the law worth reviewing before your test. Pay close attention to the new REAL ID versus Standard license choice and updated document and fee requirements, plus the stricter hands-free electronic device rules that now ban handheld phone use and carry new fines and junior operator suspensions. There is much more guidance on sharing the road safely, including the Vulnerable Road Users Law, the four-foot bicycle passing distance, the Move-Over Law, the three-second following rule, Advanced Driver Assistance Systems, new bicycle lanes and signals, and updated child restraint standards. Also new are practical sections such as recommended car safety kits, proper backing-up and three-point turn technique, tunnel driving, drowsy driving, green driving tips, the Dutch Reach, and updated road test procedures and penalties.

sections.title: REAL ID vs. Standard Massachusetts Card
sections.description: The 2026 manual introduces a choice between a REAL ID and a Standard Massachusetts license/ID, a federal compliance concept absent from the 2007 manual.
bullets: "You need to choose either a REAL ID Massachusetts Driver's License or ID Card or a Standard Massachusetts Driver's License or ID Card." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

"A REAL ID Card issued by Massachusetts is compliant with the federal REAL ID Act of 2005. This type of license or ID Card can be used to access certain federal facilities and to board flights within the United States." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Lawful Presence and New Document Requirements
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a requirement to present a document proving lawful presence in the U.S. and distinguishes document requirements between REAL ID and Standard cards.
bullets: "1 document that proves your lawful presence in the U.S." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

"A No Social Security Number Affidavit - only allowed for certain customers presenting specific document types and only for Standard Driver's Licenses (NOT for Massachusetts ID Cards)" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Prorated License Period for Limited Lawful Presence
sections.description: The 2026 manual provides for license/ID issuance for periods shorter than five years based on authorized lawful presence, a concept not in the 2007 manual.
bullets: "A REAL ID License or ID card can be issued for a period of less than five years if an applicant's authorized lawful presence (as established by the U.S. Department of Homeland Security) is for a shorter period. The minimum acceptable period of lawful presence is 12 months." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: State-to-State Program
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds participation in the State-to-State program that cancels licenses/IDs issued by other participating states.
bullets: "Massachusetts is part of the State-to-State program, which checks valid driver licenses and state issued ID cards issued by other participating states. State-to-State will cancel any driver's license or state issued ID card issued by the other participating state when a Massachusetts license or ID Card (excluding a Liquor ID) is issued." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Criminal Penalty for Foreign License Violation
sections.description: The 2026 manual specifies a criminal violation and $500 fine for operating in violation of Section 10 governing foreign license operation.
bullets: "A violation of Section 10 is a criminal violation and a first offense is subject to a fine of $500." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: JOL Driver Education Requirements
sections.description: The 2026 manual makes the 12 hours in-car training, 40 hours supervised driving, and parent participation standard requirements, whereas the 2007 manual listed 6 hours in-car and 12 hours supervised as the default with the higher figures applying only to permits issued on or after September 1, 2007.
bullets: "Successfully complete an RMV-approved driver education and training program, which includes 30 hours of classroom instruction; 12 hours of in-car, behind-the-wheel training; and six hours of in-car experience observing other student drivers." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"Complete at least an additional 40 hours of supervised, behind-the-wheel driving as shown by a certified statement provided by a parent or guardian." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Mobile Device Prohibition for Junior Operators
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a prohibition on junior operators using any mobile electronic device while driving, which does not appear in the 2007 manual.
bullets: "Drivers under 18 may not use any mobile electronic device for any reason while operating a motor vehicle. The only exception is for reporting an emergency." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Bluetooth Headset in Facial Image
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds that Bluetooth headsets are not acceptable in the photo-image, an item not mentioned in the 2007 facial image policy.
bullets: "Bluetooth headsets are not acceptable." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Electronic Filing of Driver's Education Certificate
sections.description: The 2026 manual requires passing a final exam to have a driver's education certificate electronically filed with the RMV, replacing the 2007 paper certificate process.
bullets: "Pass a final exam to have a driver's education certificate electronically filed with RMV." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: SSN Denial Notice Validity Period
sections.description: The maximum age of an acceptable SSA Denial Notice was extended from 30 days to 60 days.
bullets: "you must present the written Denial Notice (not more than 60 days old) the SSA provided you and all of the following:" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: No Social Security Number Affidavit
sections.description: Applicants without an SSN who cannot apply for one may now present a No Social Security Number Affidavit to obtain a Standard Driver's License.
bullets: "If you do not have an SSN and cannot apply for one, you can present a No Social Security Number Affidavit and apply for a Standard Driver's License (see Mass.Gov/ID for more information)." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Learner's Permit Exam Format
sections.description: The exam now has 25 questions requiring 18 correct within 25 minutes, compared to the prior 20-question test requiring 14 correct within 20 minutes.
bullets: "Each learner’s permit exam has 25 multiple-choice questions." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"To pass the exam, you must answer 18 questions correctly within the allotted time of 25 minutes." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Online Learner's Permit Exam
sections.description: The learner's permit exam may now be taken online after submitting an application at a service center.
bullets: "They are also available online at Mass.Gov/RMV after you submit your application." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Audio Exams
sections.description: Audio exams that read questions and answers aloud through headphones are now available to anyone through the ATS and online.
bullets: "Audio exams are available through the ATS and for online exams. This feature allows you to hear an automated voice read the test questions and possible answers through headphones." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Road Test Cancellation Notice Period
sections.description: The notice required to cancel or reschedule a road test without a fee increased from more than 24 hours to more than 72 hours.
bullets: "There is no additional fee if you cancel or reschedule with more than 72 hours notice." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Waiting Period After Failed Road Test
sections.description: Applicants must now wait at least 14 days before retaking a road test after failing or not appearing.
bullets: "If you fail a road test or do not appear for your scheduled test, you must wait at least 14 days before taking another test." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Road Test Sponsor Frequency Limit
sections.description: An operator may not sponsor more than three different applicants within a one-year period without RMV approval.
bullets: "Operators are not allowed to sponsor more than three different applicants within a one year period without approval from the RMV Road Test Program." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Rejected Road Tests for Impairment or Passengers
sections.description: Road tests may now be rejected for signs of alcohol/cannabis impairment of the driver or sponsor, or for unsupervised children, babies, or animals in the vehicle.
bullets: "An odor of alcohol or cannabis is coming from you or your sponsor, including from clothing or inside the vehicle" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

"Minor children, babies, or animals are present in the vehicle and cannot be left unsupervised at the Service Center. Trained service animals are allowed in the vehicle, but emotional support animals are not." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Parking Brake Requirement for Road Test Vehicle
sections.description: The road test vehicle brake requirement now specifies an accessible parking brake (manual or electric) tested at 1,200-1,300 RPMs, replacing the former accessible foot brake or emergency hand brake requirement.
bullets: "An accessible parking brake so the examiner can make an emergency stop. The parking brake can be manual or electric (push or pull button)." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

"Massachusetts regulation 540 CMR 4.04 (4) requires that parking brakes be tested by accelerating the motor to 1,200 to 1,300 RPMs with the vehicle in the lowest gear." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Out-of-State Vehicle Insurance Minimums for Road Test
sections.description: The minimum insurance coverage limits for an out-of-state road test vehicle increased from $20,000/$40,000 bodily injury and $5,000 property damage to $25,000/$50,000 and $30,000.
bullets: "If your test vehicle is registered out of state, you must show the examiner proof of insurance coverage equal to Massachusetts minimum limits, which are $25,000/$50,000 for bodily injury and $30,000 for property damage." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Donut Spare Tire Prohibition for Road Test
sections.description: A vehicle may not be used for a road test if one of its tires has been replaced by a limited-use 'donut' spare.
bullets: "A vehicle cannot be used for a road test if one of its tires has been replaced by a "donut" (limited use spare) tire." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Specialized Vehicle Features and Mechanical/Software Aid Restriction
sections.description: The road test now addresses specialized features like back-up cameras and automatic parallel parking, with a 'mechanical/software aid' restriction added when needed.
bullets: "If adaptive equipment for a legitimate medical condition is installed in the vehicle and necessary for operation, or if you need to use specialized features, a “mechanical/software aid” restriction will be added to a license." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Class M Road Test Eligibility for Under-18 Applicants
sections.description: Applicants under 18 are no longer eligible for an RMV Class M road test and must complete the MREP basic rider course to obtain a Class M license.
bullets: "If you are under 18 years old, you are not eligible for an RMV Class M road test and must complete the MREP basic rider course to get a Class M license." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Road Test Arrival Time
sections.description: Applicants are now instructed to arrive approximately 15 minutes early rather than five minutes early for the road test.
bullets: "You should arrive approximately 15 minutes early for your scheduled road test appointment." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Board of Appeals Filing Address and Contact
sections.description: The Board of Appeals address and phone number for filing a $50 appeal changed.
bullets: "One Federal St., Suite 700 • Boston, MA 02110 617-521-7794 • State.Ma.US/DOI" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Veteran's Indicator on License/ID
sections.description: A new option allowing veterans to have 'Veteran' printed on their license or ID card was added.
bullets: "If you are a veteran of the U.S. Armed Forces and were honorably discharged, you can choose to have the word \"Veteran\" printed on your license or ID card." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Deaf and Hard of Hearing Road Tests
sections.description: A new procedure for scheduling road tests with interpreters for deaf or hard of hearing applicants was added.
bullets: "If you are deaf or hard of hearing, you can schedule a road test by calling 1-877-RMV-TTDD (1-877-768-8833)." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Animals in Road Test Vehicle
sections.description: A new rule addresses service animals and emotional support animals in the road test vehicle.
bullets: "Trained service animals are allowed in the vehicle, but emotional support animals are not." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Road Test Cancellation Notice Period
sections.description: The cancellation notice period for road tests changed from less than 24 hours to less than 72 hours.
bullets: "If you fail the road test, do not appear for the road test, are rejected by the examiner, or cancel your appointment with less than 72 hours notice, you will still be charged the $35 fee, which must be paid prior to a new test being booked." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Temporary License Validity After Road Test
sections.description: The temporary license validity period after passing the road test increased from 30 days to 60 days.
bullets: "the examiner will validate your learner's permit and it will become a temporary license, valid up to 60 days (unless the permit expires before that)." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Road Test Fee
sections.description: The road test fee increased from $20 to $35.
bullets: "Road test fee - $35.00" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: License Issue/Renew Fee
sections.description: The Class D and Class M license issue fee increased from $40 to $50.
bullets: "License issue/renew fee - Class D - $50.00" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"License issue/renew fee - Class M - $50.00" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Duplicate or Amended License Fee
sections.description: The fee for amending or duplicating a license changed from $15 (amend) / $20 (duplicate) to a single $25 fee.
bullets: "Duplicate or amended license - $25.00" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Out-of-State Conversion Fees
sections.description: Out-of-state license conversion fees changed substantially from the 2007 amounts.
bullets: "Class A* - $140.00 Class B* - $140.00 Class C* - $140.00 Class D* - $115.00" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Junior Operator Conversion Supervised Driving Hours
sections.description: Junior Operator license conversion now requires 40 hours of supervised driving (30 with a driver skills program) rather than the 12 additional hours stated in 2007.
bullets: "you must log an additional 40 hours of supervised driving (30 hours if you completed a driver skills development program) as shown by a certified statement provided by a parent or guardian." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Permit Conversion Requirements
sections.description: Permit conversion now requires a certified driving record and an out-of-state permit issued less than two years ago, which were not required in 2007.
bullets: "To be eligible for conversion, you must present the current out-of-state permit issued less than two years ago. You must also provide a certified driving record (not more than 30 days old)." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Child Passenger Restraint Requirements
sections.description: The child restraint law now specifies children must remain in a restraint until at least eight years old or at least fifty-seven inches tall, replacing the prior age-five/40-pound standard.
bullets: "Infants and small children must sit in federally approved child passenger restraints until they... 1. Are at least eight years old or 2. At least fifty-seven inches tall" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Headphones/Earplug While Driving
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds an age requirement (18 or older) for using a single earplug with a cell phone and broadens the headphone prohibition to wireless devices.
bullets: "It is illegal to wear a radio headset, headphones, or any other wired or wireless device that restricts your attention to the environment while driving. If you are 18 or older, you can use one earplug for use with a cell phone." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Car Safety Kits
sections.description: A new section recommends carrying specific safety equipment items in your vehicle.
bullets: "It is recommended to carry the following items in your vehicle: • Reflective Safety Vest • Reflective Warning Triangles or LED Flares • First Aid Kit • Glass Breaker Tool • White and red cloths to tie to your vehicle during a breakdown" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Emergency Lights on Vehicles
sections.description: A new rule prohibits emergency lights on vehicles unless a permit is obtained from the RMV.
bullets: "Emergency lights (flashing, rotating, oscillating, or strobe lights) are not allowed on a vehicle unless you get a permit from the RMV." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Loud Noise Inside Vehicle
sections.description: A new rule advises avoiding loud noise levels so drivers can hear emergency sirens.
bullets: "Avoid loud noise levels in your vehicle so you can hear emergency vehicle sirens." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Zero Tolerance for Abusive Conduct on Road Test
sections.description: A new policy states the RMV has zero tolerance for violent or abusive conduct by road test applicants and sponsors.
bullets: "The RMV has a zero tolerance policy for violent or abusive conduct by road test applicants and sponsors." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Hands-Free Mobile Electronic Device Law
sections.description: The 2007 manual permitted handheld cell phone use while driving, whereas the 2026 manual prohibits the use of hand-held mobile electronic devices.
bullets: "The use of hand-held mobile electronic devices (including cell phones) while driving is prohibited in Massachusetts (Chapter 90, Section 13B and Chapter 122 of the Acts of 2019)." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"Drivers 18 and older can only use mobile electronic devices in “hands­ free” mode while driving." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"Drivers under 18 cannot use any mobile electronic device for any reason while driving. The only exception is for reporting an emergency." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Penalties for Mobile Electronic Device Use
sections.description: The 2026 manual establishes specific fines and penalties for using hand-held mobile electronic devices while driving, which did not exist in 2007.
bullets: "1st offense - $100 fine" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"2nd offense - $250 fine, plus mandatory completion of a distracted driving educational program" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"3rd and subsequent offenses - $500 fine, plus insurance surcharge and mandatory completion of a distracted driving program" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Following Distance Rule
sections.description: The safe following distance rule changed from a two-second rule in 2007 to a three-second rule in 2026.
bullets: "Use the "three-second" rule to keep a safe distance from the vehicle in front of you." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"If you reach the object before you count three, you are too close." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Tailgating Fine
sections.description: The 2026 manual specifies a fine for tailgating not stated in the 2007 manual.
bullets: "The fine for tailgating can be as high as $100." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Vulnerable Road Users Law
sections.description: The 2026 manual introduces a Vulnerable Road Users Law with a minimum passing distance requirement that did not exist in 2007.
bullets: "When you pass a vulnerable road user, you must leave a safe passing distance of at least four feet between your vehicle and the road user." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"If it is safe, you may use all or part of the lane next to you and you may cross the center line if necessary." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Advanced Driver Assistance Systems
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a section on Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS) not present in 2007.
bullets: "Many cars and trucks now come with Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS). These can make driving safer, but only if used correctly." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"You must learn about your vehicle's systems before using them." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Drowsy Driving
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a dedicated section on drowsy driving with statistics and prevention guidance not present in 2007.
bullets: "Driving while tired or drowsy can be deadly. 633 people died in 2020 from drowsy driving related crashes (source: National Highway Traffic Safety Administration)." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"The ONLY true way to protect yourself from drowsy driving is to get enough sleep and to not drive when you feel tired." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: License Plate Visibility Requirements
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a specific requirement that license plates must be visible from 60 feet at night, which was not stated in the 2007 manual.
bullets: "You must keep your license plates clean and they cannot be blocked by anything. Your plate number must be visible from 60 feet at night." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Headlight Use in Tunnels
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a requirement to use headlights while driving through a tunnel, not present in 2007.
bullets: "While driving through a tunnel" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Awareness of Deaf or Hard of Hearing Road Users
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds guidance about Deaf or Hard of Hearing pedestrians and road users not present in 2007.
bullets: "It is impossible to visually identify someone who is Deaf or Hard of Hearing. Do not assume that a pedestrian, bicyclist, or other driver can hear your car and will yield or move out of the way." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"One out of every five individuals of driving age is Deaf or Hard of Hearing." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Limited Use Vehicle Safety
sections.description: A new vehicle category for vehicles capable of speeds above 30 mph but not more than 40 mph is introduced.
bullets: "A limited use vehicle can have two or more wheels. It can go faster than 30 mph, but not more than 40 mph." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"You cannot drive a limited use vehicle on a limited-access or express state highway or any road with a speed limit faster than 40 mph." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Low Speed Vehicle Safety
sections.description: A new vehicle category for four-wheeled vehicles that can only travel between 20 and 25 mph is introduced.
bullets: "A Low Speed Vehicle (LSV) has four wheels and can only go between 20 and 25 mph. It must have a gross weight rating lower than 3,000 lbs." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"You must have a valid Class D driver's license or learner's permit to drive a low speed vehicle." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Bicycle Safety Laws
sections.description: New bicycle safety laws place responsibility on bicyclists, motorists, and bicycle renters, with police able to cite bicyclists for traffic violations.
bullets: "If a police officer sees a bicyclist commit a traffic violation, the officer can issue a citation the same way they would for a motorist." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

"A bicyclist must give the officer their true name and address when asked and can be fined for not doing so. A bicyclist can also be arrested for refusing to give their name." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"Companies that rent bicycles must offer helmets that meet all safety requirements for renters." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: At-Fault Crash Claim Threshold
sections.description: The claim payment threshold for being considered more than 50 percent at fault increased from $500 to $1000.
bullets: "Has paid more than $1000 for collision, limited collision, or damage to someone else's property or has paid more than $1000 for bodily injury (if there is no collision or damage to someone else's property over $1000 from the same incident)." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Driver Retraining Course Trigger
sections.description: The number of surchargeable events triggering mandatory driver retraining changed from five within three years to three within two years.
bullets: "If you get three or more surchargeable events on your driving record within a two-year period, you must complete the Massachusetts Driver Retraining Course." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Public Safety Surcharge on Civil Infractions
sections.description: A new $5 public safety surcharge is added to all civil motor vehicle infraction fines under Chapters 89 or 90.
bullets: "Every fine for a CMVI that comes from Chapter 89 or 90 of the Massachusetts General Laws will have an added $5 public safety surcharge." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"The lowest penalty for driving above the speed limit is a $100 fine, plus an additional $5 public safety surcharge which is added to all speeding violations." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Hearing Request Filing Fee
sections.description: A new $25 filing fee is required to request a hearing to dispute a civil motor vehicle infraction, refundable if found not responsible.
bullets: "If you request a hearing, you must pay a $25 filing fee to the RMV." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"If you are found NOT RESPONSIBLE by the court for ALL violations on the civil citation, the $25 filing fee will be refunded." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Driving Record Fees
sections.description: The driving record fee changed from a flat $15 to $20 for an attested copy and $8 for an unattested copy.
bullets: "The cost of an attested driving record is $20." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"If you do not need the driving record to be attested, you can order an unattested driving record for $8 (this option is only available online)." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Moped Violation Fine
sections.description: A specified fine of up to $100 for moped rule violations is now stated, whereas the 2007 manual referenced only suspension penalties for moped restrictions.
bullets: "You can be fined up to $100 for a violation of any of these rules." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Mobile Electronic Device Permit Suspension (Junior Operators)
sections.description: New mandatory permit suspension penalties for use of a mobile electronic device by junior operators are added.
bullets: "Conviction for the Use of a Mobile Electronic Device (text or phone) (c. 90, §8M) 60 days— first offense 180 days— second offense One year— subsequent offenses First offense requires a $100 fine, a new learner's permit exam, and a Driver Attitudinal Retraining Course. The fine is $250 for a second offense and $500 for a third offense." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"Conviction for Negligent Operation and Injury from Mobile Phone Use (c. 90, §24) 180 days—- first offense One year— second or subsequent offense" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Motorcycle Following Distance
sections.description: The recommended following distance for other vehicles behind a motorcycle changed from two-second to three-second as the comparison baseline.
bullets: "Use a four- second following distance (compared to a three-second for other motor vehicles)." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Junior Operator Suspension for Mobile Electronic Device Use
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a license suspension penalty for conviction of using a mobile electronic device (text or phone) that does not appear in the 2007 manual.
bullets: "Conviction for the Use of a Mobile Electronic Device (text or phone) (c. 90, §8M) 60 days— first offense 180 days— second offense One year— subsequent offenses" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Negligent Operation and Injury from Mobile Phone Use
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a criminal offense and suspension for negligent operation and injury from mobile phone use, which is absent from the 2007 manual.
bullets: "Conviction for Negligent Operation and Injury from Mobile Phone Use (c. 90, §24) 180 days— first offense One year— second or subsequent offense" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"Negligent Operation and Injury from Mobile Phone Use 60 days–One year $500" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: License Suspension for Unpaid Income Tax
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds failure to pay Massachusetts income tax and bad payments to the RMV as reasons for license suspension, which are not listed in the 2007 manual.
bullets: "Have failed to pay Massachusetts income tax" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

"Have made a bad payment to the RMV (for example, you paid with a check that was later rejected or you paid with a credit card and later canceled the payment with the bank)" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Drug Suspension Reason Narrowed to Trafficking
sections.description: The 2026 manual narrows the drug-related license suspension reason to drug trafficking offenses, whereas the 2007 manual listed any drug offense conviction.
bullets: "Have been convicted of certain drug trafficking offenses" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Drag Racing Penalty for Drivers Over 18
sections.description: The 2026 criminal offenses chart adds a specific drag racing suspension and fine for drivers over the age of 18, which is not present in the 2007 criminal offenses chart.
bullets: "Drag racing (by drivers over the age of 18) 30 days-180 days $500 - $1,000" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Suspension for Defacing Property/Graffiti
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a license suspension for defacing real or personal property, spray painting, or applying graffiti, which is absent from the 2007 criminal offenses chart.
bullets: "Defacing real or personal property, spraying paint or applying stickers or other graffiti (Operation of a ve­ hicle is not required) One year (or delay of one year in obtaining a License) $100" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Vehicular Manslaughter Suspension
sections.description: The 2026 criminal offenses chart lists vehicular manslaughter as a distinct offense with a 15-year to lifetime suspension, which does not appear in the 2007 chart.
bullets: "Vehicular manslaughter 15 years–Lifetime $500" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: OUI First Offense Suspension Period
sections.description: The 2026 OUI penalty chart lists a one-year suspension for a first offense, whereas the 2007 chart listed one year for first offense in its main figure but the chart formatting and surrounding values differ.
bullets: "$500–$5,000 Maximum 2 1/2 years One Year" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Standard Drink Measurements
sections.description: The 2026 manual updates the standard drink measurements for wine and liquor compared to the 2007 manual.
bullets: "Five ounce glass of wine" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"One and a half ounce serving of 80-proof liquor (even if mixed with a soft drink)" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Ignition Interlock Device Road Tests
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds procedures for scheduling a road test when an Ignition Interlock Device is required, which is not present in the 2007 manual.
bullets: "If you are required to use an Ignition Interlock Device and need to schedule a road test, you can schedule it online at Mass.Gov/RMV if you can provide a vehicle that has the device installed, has a center console brake, and has a seat for the sponsor." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Safe Ride Options Including Rideshare Apps
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds guidance to use rideshare apps and designated drivers as safe options, which is absent from the 2007 manual.
bullets: "Appoint a designated driver, take a taxi, use a rideshare app like Uber or Lyft, or call a friend or family member for a ride." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Multi-State Toll Violation Nonrenewal
sections.description: The 2026 manual expands the toll-related nonrenewal reason to include unpaid Massachusetts, Maine, or New Hampshire E-ZPass/Fast Lane toll violations, whereas the 2007 manual referenced only unpaid Fast Lane violations.
bullets: "Unpaid Massachusetts, Maine, or New Hampshire E-ZPass/Fast Lane toll violations" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Minimum Speed Limits in Specific Locations
sections.description: The 2026 manual specifies minimum speeds for the Massachusetts Turnpike and Boston Harbor tunnels, whereas the 2007 manual stated a general 45 mph minimum on interstate and limited-access highways.
bullets: "There is a minimum speed of 40 mph on the Massachusetts Turnpike. There is a minimum speed of 20 mph in the Boston Harbor tunnels (Callahan, Sumner, and Ted Williams)." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: 25 mph Business District Speed Limit
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds that thickly settled or business districts may have a 25 mph limit, and that some communities have a 25 mph thickly settled limit, which is not in the 2007 manual.
bullets: "30 mph in a thickly settled or business district (unless there are signs showing a 25 mph limit)" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"Some communities have a thickly settled speed limit of 25 mph unless posted otherwise (per M.G.L. c90, Section 17c)." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Flashing Yellow Arrow Signal
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a flashing yellow arrow signal not described in the 2007 manual.
bullets: "A flashing yellow arrow allows you to turn left or right in the direction of the arrow when oncoming traffic has a green light but there is a break in traffic." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacon
sections.description: The 2026 manual introduces Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacons for pedestrian crossings.
bullets: "Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacons are activated by pedestrians manually by a push button or by a pedestrian detection system." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"When activated, amber lights flash in an irregular pattern. You must stop for pedestrians when the beacon is flashing." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Pedestrian Hybrid Beacon
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds the Pedestrian Hybrid Beacon (PHB) for pedestrian crossings.
bullets: "A Pedestrian Hybrid Beacon (PHB) allows pedestrians to safely cross a roadway. A PHB only operates when activated by a pedestrian." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"When the top two red lights are flashing, you must stop and proceed with caution if clear." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Bicycle Signals
sections.description: The 2026 manual introduces bicycle-specific traffic signals.
bullets: "Bicycle signals are lights specifically meant for bicyclists. They display as steady red, yellow, and green bicycle symbols." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Shared Lane Markings (Sharrows)
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds Shared Lane Markings (Sharrows) not present in the 2007 manual.
bullets: "Shared Lane Markings (also known as Sharrows) help bicyclists position themselves in the right location and in the right direction in a lane that is shared with motor vehicles." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"When you see a Shared Lane Marking, you must look out for the presence of bicyclists and make sure that you leave them enough space when passing." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Bicycle Lanes
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a dedicated description of bicycle lanes and rules for crossing them.
bullets: "Bicycle lanes are portions of the roadway that are intended for use by bicyclists and are typically marked by solid white lines, along with pavement markings and signs. They are five feet wide." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"Motor vehicles may only drive in these lanes when turning on or off the road." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Advisory Bicycle Lanes
sections.description: The 2026 manual introduces advisory bicycle lanes.
bullets: "Advisory bicycle lanes are becoming common on streets that are too narrow for a full bicycle lane, but still have a lot of bicycle traffic." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"They are dashed on one or both sides to indicate that motor vehicles may use the lane space when necessary, but they must always yield to bicyclists first." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Green Pavement
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds green pavement markings for areas of potential road-sharing conflicts.
bullets: "Green pavement is used in areas where there could be road sharing conflicts between motor vehicles and bicycles." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"At a red light, you should not stop on green pavement." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Bus Lanes (Red Pavement)
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds red pavement markings for public transit lanes.
bullets: "Red pavement is used for travel lanes or station stops used by public transit systems. This includes buses, streetcars, trolleys, light-rail trains, and rapid transit fleets." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Yield Lines
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds yield lines (a series of triangles) at intersections with yield signs, which were not described in the 2007 manual.
bullets: "An intersection with a yield sign may have a YIELD line painted across it. A YIELD line looks like a series of triangles painted next to each other." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Channelizing Islands
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds rules about channelizing islands.
bullets: "A channelizing island is a traffic island or pavement marking that guides traffic along certain paths and prevents operation on areas of the roadway." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"You cannot drive over or park a motor vehicle upon any channelizing island, unless directed to do so by a police officer." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Crossing Guards
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a dedicated section on crossing guards and how to recognize their signals.
bullets: "In recent years, several crossing guards in Massachusetts have been killed or injured while on duty when struck by vehicles." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"Stop Paddles - These are hand-held stop signs that crossing guards hold up while walking out into the street to warn drivers of children crossing." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Yielding to Pedestrians When Turning into Driveways
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a new driver rule to yield to pedestrians when turning into a driveway or parking lot.
bullets: "You must yield to pedestrians when turning into a driveway or parking lot." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Move-Over Law
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a new move-over law requiring drivers to slow down and change lanes for stationary emergency vehicles.
bullets: "The “move-over law” (Chapter 418 of the Acts of 2008) requires that if you are approaching a stationary emergency vehicle and it is displaying its flashing lights, you must proceed with caution and reduce your speed to that of a reasonable and safe speed for the road conditions." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Three-Point Turns
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a new section explaining how and when to make a three-point turn.
bullets: "When there is not enough room for a U-turn, you may consider a three- point turn. This will put you in the opposite direction." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Backing Up
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a new section with steps for backing up safely.
bullets: "Shift into reverse and start backing up, while looking over your right shoulder. Ensure a safe and smooth speed while maintaning your lane." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Courtesy Crashes
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a new section warning about crashes caused by drivers waving others through traffic.
bullets: "Sometimes, drivers trying to be nice can cause confusion resulting in "courtesy crashes". Waving people in through stopped traffic, or driving through traffic when someone waves you in, creates a dangerous situation and can easily result in a crash." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: White Cane Law
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds the specific White Cane Law and prohibitions against honking or waving on blind pedestrians.
bullets: "The White Cane Law states that a driver must come to a complete stop when a blind pedestrian is crossing a street." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Passing Stopped Vehicles
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a new section about not passing stopped or turning vehicles.
bullets: "Do not pass vehicles that are stopped or are turning (both at intersections and at non-intersections). They may be stopped for another vehicle, a person, or an animal that you cannot see." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: School Bus Violation Penalty
sections.description: The penalty for a first school bus violation changed from a fine up to $2000 to a $250 fine.
bullets: "A first violation of this law can cause a license suspension and a $250 fine." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Funeral Processions
sections.description: The 2026 manual expands funeral procession rules with a legal definition, statutory citation, and detailed right-of-way provisions.
bullets: "A funeral procession is two or more vehicles, including a lead or escort vehicle, traveling during daylight hours with the body or cremated remains of a deceased person. The rules for operating in and around a funeral procession are set by M.G.L. Ch. 85, Section 14A." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

"Funeral processions have the right-of-way at intersections, with the EXCEPTION that they must yield to emergency vehicles with flashing lights or sirens or when directed by law enforcement." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Driving as Part of/Around a Funeral Procession
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds detailed rules for both driving in and around funeral processions, including specific speed limits and lighting requirements, whereas the 2007 manual only stated you must yield to processions.
bullets: "Not drive faster than 55 MPH on a highway with a speed limit of 55 MPH or higher. You must also not go more than 5 MPH slower than the speed limit on any other public way." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"Have your hazard lights on, if you are the first or last vehicle in the procession." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Move-Over Law for Stationary Emergency Vehicles
sections.description: The 2026 manual introduces the move-over law (Chapter 418 of the Acts of 2008) requiring drivers to move over and reduce speed near stationary emergency vehicles, which did not exist in the 2007 manual.
bullets: "The “move-over law” (Chapter 418 of the Acts of 2008) requires you to be cautious and reduce your speed to a speed that is reasonable and safe for the road conditions when you approach a stationary emergency vehicle with flashing lights." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

"On a highway with at least four lanes (at least two in the same direction you are heading), yield the right-of way by safely “moving over” to a lane that is not next to the lane the emergency vehicle is in." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Bus Stop Parking Fine
sections.description: The 2026 manual specifies a $100 fine for parking in a posted bus stop, which was not stated in the 2007 manual.
bullets: "In a bus stop (the penalty for parking in a posted bus stop is $100)" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Parking in a Bicycle Lane Prohibited
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a prohibition on parking in a bicycle lane, which was not listed in the 2007 manual's parking prohibitions.
bullets: "In Massachusetts, you may not park your vehicle in a bicycle lane" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: HP-DV Parking Violation Fines
sections.description: The 2026 manual specifies dollar amounts for HP-DV parking violations and adds crosshatch area prohibitions, whereas the 2007 manual only referenced a heavy fine.
bullets: "The fine for a first offense is $300. The fine for wrongful use of a disabled person or veteran plate or placard is a minimum of $500." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"In a striped crosshatch area next to an HP-DV space, even if you have disability plates or a placard" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Parking on Massachusetts Turnpike Prohibited
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a prohibition on parking on the Massachusetts Turnpike with specified fines, which was not in the 2007 manual.
bullets: "On the Massachusetts Turnpike (fines range from $15 - $100)" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Parking on Hills with No Curb
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds guidance for parking on a hill where there is no curb, which was not addressed in the 2007 manual.
bullets: "No Curb — Turn your wheels inward, toward the edge of the road." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Throwing Objects From Window Prohibited
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a general prohibition on throwing anything out of your window while driving, which was not in the 2007 manual's miscellaneous rules.
bullets: "Throw anything out of your window while driving" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Comprehensive Bicyclist Regulations
sections.description: The 2026 manual greatly expands bicyclist rules per Chapter 525 of the Acts of 2008, adding many provisions on full lane use, signaling, child passengers, and crash reporting not present in the 2007 manual.
bullets: "You can use the full lane anywhere, anytime, and on any street (except limited access or express state highways where signs specifically prohibiting bicycles have been posted), even if there is a bike lane." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

"You must report any crash involving personal injury and any crash involving property damage in excess of $100 to the police in the municipality where it occurred." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"You cannot transport a child under the age of one year on a bicycle." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Bicycle Helmet Standard Update
sections.description: The 2026 manual specifies the U.S. Consumer Product Safety Commission approval for helmets, whereas the 2007 manual only referenced approved helmets without that standard.
bullets: "A bicycle helmet approved by the U.S. Consumer Product Safety Commission must be worn by a bicycle operator or passenger under 16 years old." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Minimum Passing Distance for Bicycles
sections.description: The 2026 manual establishes a minimum four-foot passing distance when overtaking bicycles, which was not specified in the 2007 manual.
bullets: "You must stay at least four feet away when passing." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Opening Vehicle Doors and the Dutch Reach
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds rules and the Dutch Reach method regarding opening vehicle doors into bicyclists with a specified fine, not present in the 2007 manual.
bullets: "Drivers and passengers can be fined up to $100 for opening a vehicle door into an oncoming bicycle. (Chap. 90, Sec 14)" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

"When opening a vehicle door, drivers and passengers should do the following:
1. Check your rear-view mirror.
2. Check your side-view mirror.
3. Open the door with your far hand (the hand farther from the door).
This is called the "Dutch Reach" method because it originated in the Netherlands." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Bicycle Boxes
sections.description: The 2026 manual introduces bicycle boxes at intersections and rules for two-stage left turns, which were not in the 2007 manual.
bullets: "Bicycle boxes are pavement markings that are installed at intersections to allow bicyclists a safe way to turn when approaching a red light." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"Drivers must stop behind the bicycle box (even when it's empty) and wait for a green light." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Separated Bicycle Lanes
sections.description: The 2026 manual introduces separated bicycle lanes (cycle tracks and protected bike lanes), which were not addressed in the 2007 manual.
bullets: "Separated bicycle lanes, also know as cycle tracks and protected bike lanes, physically separate bicycle traffic from vehicular traffic." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Fine for Failure to Produce License/Registration
sections.description: The 2026 manual introduces a specific $35 fine for failing to produce a license or registration during a traffic stop.
bullets: "There is a $35 fine for a first offense for the failure to produce either document." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Fine for Providing False Name/Address to Officer
sections.description: The 2026 manual specifies a $100 fine for failing to comply with or providing a false name/address to an officer when license/registration are unavailable.
bullets: "If you fail to comply, or provide a false name or address, you can be fined $100 (Chapter 90, Section 25)." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Signing a Citation
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds guidance that Massachusetts does not require signing a citation but some jurisdictions do, and that signature only confirms receipt.
bullets: "Massachusetts does not require you to sign a citation, but some other jurisdictions do. Read a citation before signing. Your signature should only confirm receipt of the citation, not proof of a violation." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Emergency Notification System for Railroad Track Stall
sections.description: The 2026 manual replaces the prior instruction to call police with a procedure to call the toll-free Emergency Notification System number on the crossbuck and provide a DOT grade crossing locator number.
bullets: "If you cannot move your vehicle from the tracks, call the toll free Emergency Notification System (ENS) number that is located in the middle of the crossbuck or on the metal box near the grade crossing." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Escape Direction When Train Approaching
sections.description: The 2026 manual changes the escape instruction to running at a 45 degree angle away from the tracks in the direction the train is coming and then calling 911.
bullets: "To avoid being hit by wreckage, run in a 45 degree angle away from the tracks in the direction that the train is coming, then immediately call 911." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Safety Vests and Warning Triangle/LED Flare Placement for Breakdowns
sections.description: The 2026 manual expands breakdown instructions with detailed warning triangle/LED flare placement distances and safety vest use that were not in the 2007 manual.
bullets: "If you stop on a divided highway, place your warning triangles or LED flares: • 10 feet behind your vehicle • 100 feet behind your vehicle" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

"If you stop on a two-lane road carrying traffic in both directions or on an undivided highway, place your warning triangles or LED flares: • 10 feet behind your vehicle • 100 feet behind your vehicle • 100 feet in front of your vehicle" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"Put your safety vest on while still inside the vehicle." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Driving Through Tunnels
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds an entirely new section on tunnel safety, including procedures for crashes, entering tunnels, heavy traffic, and fires.
bullets: "Public Safety is a priority at MassDOT. Please follow these important safety tips when traveling through our tunnels." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"Hazardous Materials are prohibited, including propane." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Driver Removal Law
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds the Driver Removal Law requiring vehicles to be moved out of travel lanes after a crash with no injuries.
bullets: "If there are no injuries, the Driver Removal Law requires that vehicles be moved out of travel lanes to a safe location." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Leaving the Scene Penalties
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds specific statutory penalties for leaving the scene of a crash, including fines and imprisonment terms based on severity.
bullets: "Up to $5000 and imprisonment of up to 2 ½ years in jail or up to 10 years in state prison for leaving the scene after a crash causing personal injury to any person that resulted in death (Section 2 (a ½) (2))" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

"Up to $200 or up to two years imprisonment, or both, for leaving the scene after a crash causing damage to another vehicle or other property (M.G.L. c.90, Section 24 (2) (a))" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Fee for Crash Report Copy
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a $20 fee to request a copy of a crash report completed by law enforcement.
bullets: "You can request a copy of a crash report completed by law enforcement online at Mass.Gov/RMV for $20." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Green Driving Tips
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a new section on fuel-saving and emission-reducing driving practices, including the anti-idling law.
bullets: "Idling gets you zero miles per gallon. So when you’re stopped, switch off the engine. It saves you fuel, and it’s the law – Massachusetts state law prohibits idling for more than five minutes." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"Fuel consumption increases about five percent for every five miles per hour driven above 60 mph." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Penalty for Hitting Animal Without Notification
sections.description: The 2026 manual cites a specific statute under which a driver can be fined for hitting an animal without notifying the owner or police.
bullets: "If you hit and injure or kill a cat or dog and do not notify the animal's owner or the local police, you can be fined under M.G.L. Chapter 272, Section 80H." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Special Design Plates
sections.description: The 2026 manual does not contain the section describing specialty/environmental fundraising license plates and their associated fees.
bullets: "In addition to the initial registration fee, specialty license plates require a special fee each renewal. In 1995, Massachusetts introduced its first environmental fundraising plate, which features the tail of a right whale and two roseate terns." (2007 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

"The special fee for these plates, which is $40 every two years, is contributed to the Massachusetts Environ- mental Trust, which provides grants to educate and preserve the Massachusetts environ- ment." (2007 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Automotive Traffic Convention
sections.description: The 2026 manual does not include the list of countries party to the Automotive Traffic Convention used for foreign license recognition.
bullets: "Albania Algeria Argentina*+ Australia Austria Bahamas, The Bangladesh Barbados Belgium Belize Benin Botswana Brazil* Bulgaria Cambodia Canada Central African Re- public Chile Colombia* Congo Congo, Democratic Rep. Costa Rica*" (2007 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
